description: This Java interface defines a builder pattern for constructing acknowledgment topic paths within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter module. It extends an existing TopicPathBuildable interface, providing methods to set custom acknowledgment labels and to indicate aggregated acknowledgments.

classes.name: AcknowledgementTopicPathBuilder
classes.description: Interface for building acknowledgment topic paths with customizable labels and aggregation options.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Sets a custom acknowledgment label on the topic path, enabling precise acknowledgment message identification.

methods.name: aggregatedAcks
methods.description: Configures the builder to remove custom labels, signaling the use of aggregated acknowledgments.
